subject: Step1 pre-frame preload (INTERSECT DCD) implemented, gated, host oracle PASS; heavy tests waiting on thermal/lease
body: Mesa 81daea66 pan_fb_preload.c v9 + pan_desc.c pre_frame_0 + pan_fix_frame_shader_mode (TSIX-2033) + panvk frame shaders (pixel_coord+txf). n2r: n2r_addresses.frame_shader_dcds (additive; 0 = byte-identical packets, asserted) -> FB pre_frame_0=INTERSECT (ALWAYS if any target forces clean tile write); new n2r_build_frame_preload builds the LOAD preload block with no job: 3-DCD array at block+N2R_FRAME_DCDS(=N2R_JOB+128), DCD0 clean_fragment_write, RT0, 1 blend, FORCE_LATE (program keeps ATEST, not is_blit), DCD1/2 zero. New FS tests/shaders/nord2_frame_preload.frag = texelFetch(src, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy)) (no varyings; r59 POSITION_XY preload) generated by generate_preload.{c,sh} as n2_frame_preload_shader (legacy n2_preload_* bytes unchanged). Bridge: n2mb_preframe(b,mode) + env NORD2_METAL_PREFRAME=0/1, default NORD2_PREFRAME_DEFAULT (0): single LOAD draws (incl. snapshot) and batches drop the chained full-screen preload tiler job; tiles without geometry are neither preloaded nor written back (today every LOAD pass round-trips the whole target: 2x10.97 MB for the 1125x2436 display). Files (mine): nord2_metal_render.c feb7c895 .h d2696636, nord2_metal_bridge.c 91c6a3c1 .h 0a44e9c9, tests/nord2_metal_render_test.c b53bf9a1 (Mesa genxml unpack oracle), tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c e7d553df (fake walks FB word0/word6 + DCD array), generate_preload.c d2729b20 / .sh b3896b74 (render preload tool; tell me if someone else owns it), nord2_preload.h f2dcaee4. PASS: iOS -Werror syntax bridge (both defaults) + render; render_semantics oracle; metal_bridge_test ASan (all PASS incl. new preframe block). PENDING: full run_host_tests, integration, CA test with preframe on/off - waiting because encode-cpu-opus's profile build is the one heavy job and sensors read 90C. Hardware unverified: INTERSECT frame DCDs on G77 JM need a device A/B (NORD2_METAL_PREFRAME=1 vs 0).
